hooks.command: f=$(python3 -c "import json,sys; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(d.get('tool_input',{}).get('file_path') or d.get('tool_input',{}).get('notebook_path') or '')"); case "$f" in *.py) ;; *) exit 0 ;; esac; cd /home/bgalmes/Projects/rubit-mcp-mail || exit 0; [ -x .venv/bin/ruff ] || exit 0; .venv/bin/ruff format "$f" >/dev/null 2>&1; .venv/bin/ruff check --fix "$f" >/dev/null 2>&1; chk=$(.venv/bin/ruff check "$f" 2>&1); pr=$(.venv/bin/pyright --pythonpath .venv/bin/python 2>&1); ok=1; echo "$chk" | grep -q "All checks passed" || ok=0; echo "$pr" | grep -q "^0 errors" || ok=0; if [ "$ok" = "0" ]; then { echo "Lint/type-check issues remain after editing $f:"; echo "$chk"; echo "$pr"; } >&2; exit 2; fi; exit 0
